job.title: [Post] Kensium Hiring Integration Developers Dell Boomi iPaaS

tailoring.headline: Integration Developer & SAP Commerce Cloud Specialist | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms including SAP Commerce Cloud. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and integration workflows across PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, and Kubernetes. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer operating in a techno-functional capacity bridging business requirements and technical execution.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Integration Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Integration Developer opportunity, bringing over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce development and integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My background centers on designing robust backend services, data pipelines, and API integrations for complex platforms.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex data pipelines and data flows between PIM, ERP, and SAP Commerce platforms using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for enterprise storefronts and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Workflow & Automation
bullets.text: Engineered automated data migration and integration workflows, custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data processing.

bullets.label: Automated Testing
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites using JUnit to maintain rigorous code quality, system stability, and deployment reliability.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how my integration and backend expertise can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise integration and SAP Commerce expertise to your team. My hands-on experience building complex data pipelines, RESTful APIs, and cross-platform workflows aligns directly with your technical objectives, and I am excited to deliver robust, scalable integration solutions for your enterprise projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of backend development and enterprise integration expertise across SAP Commerce ecosystems, REST APIs, and automated data workflows.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of experience in SAP Commerce, backend integration, and data workflows at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in your Integration Developer role. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Integration Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Integration Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise backend systems, REST APIs, and complex data integrations across SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical capabilities in Java, Spring, and workflow automation.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience fits your requirements.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
